name: landlock_create_ruleset
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_landlock_create_ruleset, const struct landlock_ruleset_attr *attr, size_t size, uint32_t flags);
description: This system call creates a new Landlock ruleset, which identifies a set of rules for actions on objects. The returned file descriptor can be used with other Landlock functions to add rules and restrict processes.

parameters.name: attr
parameters.description: Points to a structure specifying the ruleset's properties, including a bitmask of handled filesystem actions.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Must be the size of struct landlock_ruleset_attr for compatibility reasons.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Must be 0 if attr is used; otherwise, can be set to LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION to retrieve the highest supported ABI version.

return_value.success: Returns a new Landlock ruleset file descriptor, or the Landlock ABI version if flags is set accordingly
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set appropriately

errors.description: Landlock is supported by the kernel but disabled at boot time.
Unknown flags, or unknown access, or too small size.
Attr was not a valid address.
